notes.title: Moss Overhaul Update
notes.content:
[olist]
Fixed the Nutrient Recyling Bug, it now properly gives 2x DNA for the same price
Added an option to the options menu to disable the warning for rabbit attacks
Continued work on the Tooltips, this is still ongoing
Massive Changes to Moss
[/olist]

Changes to Moss


 Moss base sugar production rate increased 10x
 Added a new trait, Proto Cam Pathway for 7 DNA, double Sugar Production
 Added a Lichen Store item that will reset the DNA threshold
 Fixed the bug with the Moss/Succulent column where Cam Pathway traits were actually lowering the sugar production rates if Succulent column was active
 Fixed the bug where Succulent Column by itself was giving more sugar than it should have
 These changes will make the Moss early game significantly faster, the middle game slightly slower, and the end game even faster.

notes.title: MAJOR MOSS BUG FIX
notes.content:
Hotfix for Moss Efficiency in Sunlight and Water Conversion: We have implemented an urgent hotfix addressing a critical issue discovered in our game. It has come to our attention that Moss has been converting Sunlight and Water into Sugar at only 50% of the intended efficiency. 

 This was not part of the game's original design and has been present since the game's launch. 

    We deeply apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused to our players. It is confirmed that the plant's conversion efficiency has now been adjusted to its correct value. This change will ensure a more balanced and intended gameplay experience.

    We appreciate your understanding and continued support as we strive to make our game the best it can be. Thank you for your patience as we work on delivering a seamless and enjoyable gaming experience.

Note for Dedicated Players: To those players who have stuck with Moss despite its slower conversion rate, you have our respect and admiration.  🫡

notes.title: 12/16/23 Bug fixes, Formulas, another new background
notes.content:
Sugar Production Rate Transparency: Now, when hovering over sugar, you will see the base rate of production, exclusive of seasonal variations. This feature is in the process of being further refined. The update was expedited to address the urgent mushroom store bug.

 Tree Icon Insights: Hovering over the Tree Icon, which represents size and maturity, will now provide detailed information on how this attribute is calculated.

 New Background for Moss: We have introduced another background, the one a Bromeliad for Moss.

 Adjusted Moss Trait Pricing: The cost of top-tier traits for Moss has been reduced to more reasonable levels, making them mush more accessible.

 Mushroom Store Bug Fix: We have resolved an issue where root rot was incorrectly affecting plants other than those involved in mushroom store transactions. Please note that mushroom store purchases still utilize your maximum available funds towards the selected multiplier.

 Mobile Web Player Update: Functionality for mobile web players using the Mushroom store has been aligned with that of Desktop players, ensuring a consistent experience across platforms.

 Time Boost Clarity: Time Boosts will now be displayed in ticks, replacing previous obscure terminology, for better understanding and ease of use.

 Backend Enhancements: Additional improvements have been made on the backend to enhance overall system performance and user experience.

 Upcoming Sugar Tooltip Formula Refinement: Plans are underway to refine the tooltip formula for sugar. This will include seasonal modifiers for autumn and hide the efficiency multiplier if it is set to 1.

 Future Tooltip Enhancements: We are working on introducing two new tooltip refinements. The first will explain the Needles formula when hovering over the 'Buy Needles' button, and the second will detail the cost of leaves when hovering over the 'Buy Leaves' button.
